note: Addendum to verdict.json, added 2026-07-18. verdict.json itself is left unmodified as the original analyzer's output. This file adds precision/naming corrections computed from the SAME already-recorded main-window data (wsl_transport_status.csv, main window 1784377173.902174-1784377413.902174 Unix seconds) -- no data was re-collected, no pilot was re-run.

rtt_status_snapshot_ms.provenance: 1Hz snapshot from /epuck_bridge/status of the most recently completed individual WSL-to-Pi-to-WSL command-acknowledgement RTT (wsl_epuck_tcp_bridge.py: rtt_ms = (time.monotonic() - command_sent) * 1000.0, both operands WSL time.monotonic()). NOT a per-transaction census -- commands are sent roughly every 0.1s (~2400 over 240s), only 240 were sampled via the 1Hz status tick.

state_age_s.formula: time.time() - self._last_state_time, computed inside wsl_epuck_tcp_bridge.py's _publish_status(); self._last_state_time is set to time.time() inside _record_state() at the moment a state message from the Pi was successfully decoded
state_age_s.both_operands_source: WSL-local time.time() calls in the same Python process -- no Pi-side timestamp is read or subtracted

cmd_vel_zero_motion_confirmation.method: four joint, independent checks -- none is treated as sufficient alone
checks: bag: 0 /cmd_vel messages recorded (topic absent from ros2 bag info's topic list) -- proves nothing was recorded on the WSL ROS graph during the bag's own recording window, does not by itself prove no command existed anywhere else in the system
WSL-side live recorder: 0 nonzero /cmd_vel messages observed via its own independent subscription for the same window
Pi driver foreground log: user-confirmed (not independently re-verified by the analyzer) continuous 'New velocity, left 0 and right 0'
manual visual observation: robot wheels remained physically stationary throughout

application_state_sequence_delivery_rati.applies_to: the sensor-extended bridge (NOT used in this attempt) -- reserved naming for the next pilot
application_state_sequence_delivery_rati.meaning: Pi application-level state-sequence receipt completeness as measured at the WSL bridge (state_unique_received / (state_unique_received + state_missing))
application_state_sequence_delivery_rati.must_not_be_auto_equated_with: rosbag PDR (a separate, bag-vs-live-source comparison, computed independently)
